findings.body: The prior scope defect remains open: lines 158–159 rewrite acceptance coverage assigned to the later MODEL and MEMORY tasks, with accompanying plan-read metadata changes. These edits are outside the explicitly permitted SCHEMA paths and are unnecessary for delivering the eight additive tables and generation constraints. Revert them and leave those changes to their owning tasks or a separately approved planning change.
findings.title: Remove out-of-scope changes to future MODEL and MEMORY tasks
